authoritative_sources.status_signal: presence of a detail notice under the approved-listing path with an explicit certified date

approval_rule: Never infer approval from keywords alone. Require authoritative DRNA approved-listing manifestation, stable permit/expediente identifier, and explicit certified date.
disappearance_rule: A record disappearing from the listing is not revocation, denial, supersession, or invalidation. Preserve the prior manifestation and classify the new absence as SOURCE_ABSENCE until independently adjudicated.
geometry_rule: Administrative approval and geometry identity are separate claims. ZMT, parcel, approved boundary, and servidumbre de salvamento geometries require independent source binding and adjudication.
